tool.name: WindowMasker
tool.description: NCBI WindowMasker genome-frequency repeat/low-complexity intervals as content-annotated BED6
tool.command: set -o pipefail && #if $input.is_of_type('fasta.gz') gunzip -c '$input' #else cat '$input' #end if | awk '/^>/{print;next}{print toupper(\$0)}' > in.fa && windowmasker -mk_counts -in in.fa -out counts && windowmasker -ustat counts -in in.fa -outfmt interval | awk -f '$__tool_directory__/interval2bed.awk' | python3 '$__tool_directory__/lc_classify.py' in.fa - | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > '$output'
tool.help:
**WindowMasker** (NCBI BLAST+) learns over-represented k-mers directly from the input genome (no repeat library needed) and finds repeats in two passes (`-mk_counts` and `-ustat`).
The tool outputs **BED6** with content annotations (`name` = repeat-unit signature, `score` = purity × 1000, `strand` = `.`). It converts the input sequence to uppercase first so it computes the mask from sequence alone.
